gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo thun mong min pa'i skor las:'phags pa re man+ta'i sgrub pa bzhugs so:dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo thun mong min pa'i skor las: 'phags pa re man+ta'i sgrub pa bzhugs so: 1$0000300dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo:

ār+ya re man+ta yi sgrub pa ni: gtor ma dpe'u ris ltar bca': de la mngon rtogs ltar du tsakli 'dzug: de nas dmigs pa 'di ltar bya: rang gi mdun du re man+ta: dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: lus la gser khrab ser po gsol: g.yas pas ral gri nam mkhar g.yugs: rta gdon rnams kyi mgo bo 'gems: g.yon pas lcags kyus rta rnams 'gugs: g.yang can rta sngo chu ris zhon: dbu yi steng na bya khyung lding: klu rnams srog rtsa he tang tang: phrag pa g.yas g.yon bya khra lding: sa bdag phran bu 'dar chum chum: mdun g.yas rgya stag pho mo bdun: mdun g.yon seng ge pho mo bdun: shar nas 'gugs byed pho nya stong: rang 'dra dkar po lcags kyu g.yas: lho nas rtsol byed ser po stong: rang 'dra g.yas pas ne'u le: nub nas bya ra byed mkhan stong: rang 'dra dmar po g.yas ral gri: byang nas dgra bgegs sgrol mkhan stong: rang 'dra nag po g.yas lcags sdig: bdag la dngos grub ster ba'i phyir: spyan 'dren phaiṃ phaiṃ bdag gis 'bod: mna' dgu bzhag pa'i shag po yin: pha ma byas na'ang de rang yin: dpon g.yog byas na'ang de rang yin: tsha zhang byas na'ang de rang yin: oṃ ār+ya re man+ta swā hā: hrīṃ hrīṃ dza dzaḥpheṃ pheṃ: de nas sngags 'di bzla'o: oṃ ār+ya re man+ta swā hā: gho ra sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: des ni rta rnams 'phel 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha tham gu h+ye: 'di thun mong ma yin pa karma chags med kho na'i chos skal yin gsungs skad de/ sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gnyis me pho sprel lo khrum zla'i yar tshes bdun la gu ru drag pos dngos su bka' bstsal pa'o/// /
